plain: Tim Burchett is a US congressman from Tennessee. A podcast host, Joe Rogan, says Burchett recently stated that five areas in the world's oceans have been found where unknown craft regularly come out of the water. Another podcast host, Jesse Michels, repeats this on several episodes, calling them five hotspots under the oceans, and once says five or six deep-water areas with more sightings than usual. If true, it would mean something has bases or regular routes deep under the sea.
